gen-gf-oxanium-gf-anek-devanagari: Oxanium has a rounded-nib look, with no swelling at the stroke ends. Anek Devanagari sits beneath it with a tall middle zone and distinctly open mouths, a modern sans that lets the heading do the shouting.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-anek-gujarati: Anek Gujarati has lowercase that rivals its capitals, with a gaping c opening. Over it, Oxanium's constant-width arms and legs supply the commanding punch, while the sans below stays clean and approachable.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-anek-malayalam: Oxanium is a display face with a monoweight stroke throughout and lowercase that looks big and commanding. Anek Malayalam then reads smoothly, caps hugging the lowercase, in a contemporary sans-serif.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-anek-odia: Oxanium's tubular strokes look like bent copper pipe. Anek Odia's rounds stay unsealed, like an unlatched hook, and its capitals barely rise above lowercase, which is what softens all that pipework.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible: Wide-set terminals on the s make this plain sans read clearly, with capitals a touch clipped. Atkinson Hyperlegible handles the quiet reading while Oxanium, with straight-edged constant strokes, takes the display lines.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-: Oxanium has hairline-free, swell-free letterforms that look big and commanding. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono spaces its letters far open and clips its capitals beside the lowercase, breathing into the white space beneath.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-biryani: Oxanium's uninterrupted monoline strokes give it a commanding look. Biryani does the quieter job, with a large eye on every e and small counters that never clog, while Oxanium owns the display.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-blinker: Blinker keeps lines at a steady thickness, its lowercase filling most of the height. And Oxanium, the commanding display face, does the loud part, leaving the sans to be approachable.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Sharp and unbending, Oxanium holds its line width through every turn. Carrois Gothic SC leaves a clear opening at every curve's end and keeps capitals close to lowercase height, a friendly sans-serif counterweight.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-chivo: Oxanium's true monoline drawing gives it a commanding, distinctive look. Chivo, a sans-serif with lowercase packed up toward the caps, keeps every curved opening visibly open, so paragraphs run with steady, approachable texture.
